notes: S&P AT: current assets + net PP&E + other noncurrent assets (guide item 6). FASB Assets is the balance-sheet total.
S&P ACT = CHE + RECT + INVT + ACO. FASB AssetsCurrent.
Helper for CHE: cash and equivalents (S&P CH).
Fallback: includes restricted cash; S&P CHE includes cash in escrow.
Legacy tag.
S&P IVST short-term investments.
S&P CHE = CH + IVST; FASB element is that sum (calc child of AssetsCurrent).
CH required.
IVST optional (zero when absent).
S&P RECT: all claims collectible within one year (trade + tax refund + other). FASB ReceivablesNetCurrent is the total.
Trade only; used when no total is filed.
S&P INVT inventories total.

No inventory total filed: the net-of-reserve components the filer tags (FASB InventoryNet children other than gross inventory and the LIFO reserve, which would double count) and industry inventory lines.
S&P XPP prepaid expenses.
Helper: S&P ACOX current assets other (sundry).
S&P PPENT = PPEGT - accumulated DD&A.
S&P PPEGT gross PP&E.
S&P IVAO: other investments and advances; equity-method investments are a separate item (IVAEQ). FASB LongTermInvestments includes equity-method investments so it ranks second.
Includes equity-method investments (IVAEQ in S&P); fallback.
S&P GDWL.
Helper: S&P INTANO.
S&P INTAN total intangibles incl. goodwill; FASB element = Goodwill + IntangibleAssetsNetExcludingGoodwill.
S&P LCT = AP + LCO + DLC + TXP.
Helper: S&P DD1 long-term debt due in one year (incl. capital leases).
FASB calc: LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligationsCurrent = LongTermDebtCurrent + FinanceLeaseLiabilityCurrent.
No current-maturities total filed: the FASB calc children of LongTermDebtCurrent the filer tags, plus finance leases.
Helper: S&P NP notes payable; FASB ShortTermBorrowings includes commercial paper and overdrafts (its calc children).
No ShortTermBorrowings total filed: its FASB calc children the filer tags.
S&P DLC = DD1 + NP; FASB DebtCurrent is debt and finance lease obligation classified current (parent of ShortTermBorrowings).
S&P AP: trade obligations due within one year.
S&P AP includes accounts payable and accrued expenses when no breakout is given.
S&P TXP: accrued income tax due within one year.
Includes non-income taxes (FASB); S&P accepts a combined figure.
S&P XACC accrued expenses.
Helper: S&P LCOX.
S&P DLTT: debt due after one year incl. capitalized lease obligations (guide item 9).
No combined total filed. FASB calc: LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligations = LongTermDebtNoncurrent + FinanceLeaseLiabilityNoncurrent; S&P DLTT includes capitalized lease obligations (guide item 9).
No long-term debt total filed: the FASB calc children of LongTermDebtNoncurrent the filer tags, plus finance leases.

As variant 2 when LongTermNotesAndLoans is not filed: its children LongTermNotesPayable and LongTermLoansPayable stand in (a separate variant so a filer tagging parent and child is not counted twice).
S&P TXDITC = TXDB + ITCB; excludes current deferred taxes. FASB element retired after 2024.
Net DTL after ASU 2015-17 noncurrent classification.
S&P MIB noncontrolling interest.
S&P Xpressfeed LT = LCT + DLTT + TXDITC + LO (noncontrolling interest outside; the 2003 guide included minority interest before SFAS 160).
S&P PSTK carrying value: nonredeemable preferred (2003 guide item 130). FASB PreferredStockValue is nonredeemable preferred.
Preferred carried with its paid-in capital (common for banks: JPM 2023 27,404).
S&P PSTKRV redemption value.
S&P TSTKP preferred treasury stock.
S&P SEQ = CEQ + PSTK; FASB StockholdersEquity is parent equity excluding noncontrolling interest.
S&P CEQ = SEQ - PSTK.
S&P RE.
S&P CSHO common shares outstanding at year end (shares; exported in millions).
Shares issued less treasury shares (balance sheet parenthetical).
S&P DRC deferred revenue current (ASC 606 element first).
S&P DRLT deferred revenue long-term.
S&P DCVT convertible debt.
S&P RECTA cumulative translation adjustment.
S&P MSA marketable securities adjustment.

S&P SALE: gross sales and other operating revenue less discounts, returns and excise taxes, including revenue sources expected to continue (finance subsidiaries, leasing). The filed total first; ASC 606 contract revenue alone omits non-contract revenue (GM Financial, Walmart membership income), so it is used only with RevenueNotFromContractWithCustomer added. Revenues labelled as including other income is refused by the presentation rule (compustat_presentation_rules.csv).
ASC 606: contract revenue plus revenue not from contracts with customers (FASB both children of Revenues).
Including excise taxes the filer collects: the last resort for SALE (S&P excludes excise).
Banks: S&P bank revenue is total interest income plus noninterest income.
S&P REVT revenue total (Xpressfeed item; not in 2003 guide). Same ladder as SALE.
ASC 606: contract revenue plus revenue not from contracts with customers (FASB both children of Revenues).
Including excise taxes the filer collects: the last resort for SALE (S&P excludes excise).
Banks: S&P bank revenue is total interest income plus noninterest income.
Helper: as-filed cost of revenue in taxonomy order (sec_gold.concept_tag_map cost_of_revenue).
S&P COGS excludes depreciation allocated to cost of sales and amortization of intangibles (guide item 41); the excluding-D&A elements are that definition.
As-filed cost of revenue less the D&A the filer tags inside it (S&P removes depreciation from COGS).

No cost of revenue filed. S&P (guide item 41): total operating costs of nonmanufacturing companies are COGS when no breakdown is reported; by S&P's identity OIADP = SALE - COGS - XSGA - DP, COGS = SALE - XSGA - DP - OIADP (XBRL operating income can include special items, which then sit in COGS).
Banks and savings institutions (guide item 41): interest expense plus provision for loan losses.
Required: only lenders file a loan-loss provision, so an industrial firm never takes this variant.
Helper: D&A tagged inside cost of revenue.
S&P XRD.
Helper: FASB SG&A (children G&A and selling/marketing; excludes R&D).
S&P XSGA includes research and development expense (guide item 189 includes list no. 22); FASB SG&A excludes it.
No SG&A total filed: G&A + selling/marketing + R&D.
S&P XAD advertising; excludes selling and marketing expense.
Includes marketing (FASB parent of AdvertisingExpense); fallback.
S&P DP includes amortization of intangibles and depletion (guide item 14); FASB element covers tangible and intangible and depleting assets.
S&P XINT interest and related expense.
S&P TXT income taxes total.
S&P TXDI deferred taxes (income account).
S&P PI pretax income.
S&P NI: income after discontinued operations and extraordinary items.
S&P NI is before preferred dividends: income available to common plus preferred dividends and adjustments.
S&P IB: after taxes and minority interest, before discontinued operations and extraordinary items (guide item 18). FASB element is continuing operations attributable to parent.
Net income less discontinued operations attributable to the parent.
Filers that tag only the consolidated discontinued-operations element.
No discontinued operations tagged.
S&P NOPI.
S&P OIADP: after COGS, SG&A and DD&A. XBRL operating income also includes items S&P moves to special items.
S&P OIBDP = OIADP + DP.
Xpressfeed EBITDA; taken as OIBDP.
S&P EPSPI basic EPS incl. extraordinary items.
S&P EPSPX basic EPS excl. extraordinary items.
Basic EPS includes discontinued operations; S&P EPSPX excludes them.
S&P DVC: common dividends declared as on the equity statement (guide item 21). FASB DividendsCommonStock is declared.
Paid (cash flow statement); fallback.
All dividends paid (cash flow statement); can include preferred: last fallback.
S&P DVP.
Xpressfeed DVT total dividends.
S&P DV: cash dividends paid on common and preferred (statement of cash flows).
S&P DVPA preferred dividends in arrears. FASB defines the element as a duration fact.
S&P dividends per share declared.
S&P OANCF includes discontinued operations: total first.
S&P CAPX (statement of cash flows).
S&P PRSTKC: uses of funds decreasing common and/or preferred stock; FASB element is common + preferred repurchases.
S&P SSTK includes equity offerings and option/warrant exercises; FASB element is common + preferred + options + other equity.
S&P DLTIS.
S&P DLTR.
S&P DLCCH changes in current debt.
Helper: S&P CSHPR shares used to calculate basic EPS (shares; exported in millions).
S&P ACO: current assets other than cash and short-term investments, receivables and inventories (guide: Current Assets - Other), i.e. the remainder of ACT; it includes prepaid expenses (XPP + ACOX).
No current-asset total filed: prepaid + other current assets lines.
S&P LCO: accrued expenses and residual current liabilities not debt, trade payables or income taxes (guide: Current Liabilities - Other), i.e. the remainder of LCT.
No current-liability total filed: accrued + other current liabilities lines.
S&P LO: noncurrent liabilities not debt, deferred taxes or minority interest (guide: Liabilities - Other), i.e. the remainder of LT = LCT + DLTT + TXDITC + LO.
No liability totals filed: the other noncurrent liabilities line.
Helper: S&P IVAEQ investments and advances, equity method.
S&P AO: long-term assets not PP&E, investments and advances or intangibles (guide: Assets - Other), i.e. the remainder of AT = ACT + PPENT + IVAEQ + IVAO + INTAN + AO.
No current-asset total filed: the other noncurrent assets line.
Helper: temporary (mezzanine) equity, outside both liabilities and equity.
No Liabilities total filed: liabilities and equity less total equity (incl. noncontrolling interest) less temporary equity.
As variant 1 when equity is filed only as parent equity plus noncontrolling interest.
No parent-equity total filed: total equity including noncontrolling interest less the noncontrolling interest (FASB: StockholdersEquity is the parent portion of this element).
Helper: FASB: the difference between preference in liquidation and the par or stated value of the preferred shares (the excess, not the total).
S&P PSTKL: involuntary liquidating value of preferred outstanding = carrying value + the FASB excess of liquidation preference over par.
S&P CEQT (guide item 11): common equity at liquidation value minus intangibles; deductions are unpaid preferred dividends, the excess of preferred liquidating value over carrying value, intangibles.
